external_publication: Only redacted source hashes, commands, synthetic evidence and aggregate client counters; no client request bodies or secrets.
baseline_calibration_note: First baseline C1/C4 batches showed many hotel-lights outputs truncated at2048. Retain all results; score is budget-confounded, not a full model quality judgment. Use workload for request-local generation/latency and separate authoritative verifier for correctness. Do not infer candidate quality from truncation score alone.
rate_definition: Completion-stats aggregate_gen_tok_s is sum(output tokens)/sum(per-request generation seconds), a request-time-weighted generation rate, NOT total concurrent server throughput. Comparisons will label it accordingly. Passive server token counters include clients.
memory_comparison_note: Fresh-process free VRAM is not comparable with an 11-hour baseline warmed by long prompts. For each memory-capacity arm, measure after the same >=500K retrieval gate, then overlap workload. Do not attribute initial ~200MiB post-restart difference to B12X patches.
concurrency_gate: Before accepting MTP/fairness or final memory selection, exercise 8 and12 concurrent seeded requests with 1K unique inputs and128 outputs, requiring complete streams and no engine errors. This covers production max-sequence dispatch beyond C4 workload.
fairness_comparison: Use identical fairness-capable image with selector OFF versus compute_share0.4. Three fresh64K-prefill/2048-output overlap trials plus C8/C12 completeness gate per mode. This is the targeted fairness endpoint; do not infer fairness from mostly pure-decode hotel workload. Prefer >=20% improvement in request-local decode progress/TPOT across >=2/3 trials with long-prefill TTFT <=2x off control, no correctness or engine failures; otherwise keep off.
